technical_and_design_decisions: Target environment is a Spring enterprise application / Spring XD architecture managing data stream processing and message routing.

For U1 (Alternative DLQ), implement a configurable error channel publishing strategy that enriches message headers with exception details, failure cause, and formatted stack trace before routing to the alternate DLQ destination.

For U2 (DB Change Event Stream), develop an out-of-the-box CDC (Change Data Capture) source module using database log tailing / polling mechanisms to output structured change events onto Spring Integration channels.
For U3 (RabbitMQ Cluster HA/FT), configure multi-node RabbitMQ connection factories with automatic reconnection, address array parsing, and topology recovery.
For U4 (Gemfire Upgrade), upgrade Gemfire to version 8.1 and adapt Spring Data Gemfire / Gosling release train API updates across data grid modules.

For U5 (Colocated Streams & Leader Election), implement local deployment mode for colocating stream modules within a single container JVM and integrate Apache Curator / Zookeeper for module leader election and failover.
For U6 & U7 (SI & SI Kafka Upgrades), upgrade Spring Integration core to target milestone/GA version to incorporate JMX MBean improvements and update Spring Integration Kafka adapters.

For U8 (Spring Boot & Dependency Sync), upgrade root build scripts to Spring Boot 1.2.3.RELEASE and align all specified third-party library versions (Jackson 2.5.1, Groovy 2.4.3, Tomcat 8.0.21, Jetty 9.2.9, Spring Security 4.0.1, etc.).
assumptions: Development and testing will be executed by a single senior Java/Spring developer.
Upstream dependency artifacts (Spring Data Gosling, Gemfire 8.1, SI Kafka, Spring Boot 1.2.3) are available in enterprise or public Maven repositories.
Database change capture (U2) will support common relational databases (e.g., MySQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle) via standard source channel adapters.
Automated unit and integration test suites exist and will be updated to validate dependency upgrades and new module behavior.

activities.activity_name: Technical Design and Dependency Matrix Alignment
activities.activity_description: Analyze requirement specs, verify compatibility between Spring Boot 1.2.3, Spring Integration, Gemfire 8.1, and third-party dependencies, and document module design details.

activities.activity_name: Implement Alternative DLQ with Exception Header Enrichment (U1)
activities.activity_description: Create configurable DLQ routing options, implement error handler interceptor to attach exception type, root message, and stack trace headers to dead-lettered messages.

activities.activity_name: Develop Database Change Stream Source Module (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement an OOTB database change event stream module (CDC) enabling incremental database change capture and streaming to messaging channels and downstream sinks.

activities.activity_name: Implement RabbitMQ HA/FT Cluster Connection Support (U3)
activities.activity_description: Enhance RabbitMQ connection configuration to accept cluster node address lists, configure client failover properties, and verify Spring AMQP multi-host connection management.
Upgrade Gemfire dependencies to 8.1, update Spring Data Gemfire components to Gosling release train, and resolve API breaking changes in region and client cache handling.

activities.activity_name: Colocated Stream Deployment and Leader Election Failover (U5)
activities.activity_description: Develop single-container local stream colocation capability and integrate Zookeeper/Curator leader election to enable dynamic failover of stream processing modules between containers.

activities.activity_name: Spring Integration Core & SI Kafka Upgrades (U6, U7)
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Spring Integration core to latest GA, integrate JMX MBean improvements, upgrade Spring Integration Kafka extension, and adapt channel adapter configurations.

Update build configuration files (POMs/Gradle) to Spring Boot 1.2.3.RELEASE and update all listed dependency versions (Logback, Jackson, H2, Undertow, ActiveMQ, Tomcat, Jetty, Elasticsearch, Liquibase, Spring Security, etc.). Fix breaking API changes.

activities.activity_name: Integration Testing, Regression Verification, and Documentation
activities.activity_description: Execute end-to-end integration tests across updated components, perform regression testing for existing streams, fix discovered issues, and update developer documentation.
